_comment: A NAMING layer, not a taxonomy. Groups are fitted to the layers a
checkpoint actually contains; these rules only supply human labels.
A leaf no rule matches still gets a group named by its raw leaf path,
so an unfamiliar architecture works without touching this file.
Rules are ordered -- the first match wins. 'fine' is deliberately
empty: with no rules every distinct leaf path is its own part, which
is the identity fit and needs no per-model configuration at all.
